title: Chapter 133 Mr. Architect
content:
Chapter 133 Mr. Architect

Zhao Bond paused and then continued: "The soul crystal is mainly used to enhance the power of the soul. You can also take it.

As for the tool man, if he wants to awaken his past memories, he needs to rely on his own strength to break through Lord Zach's soul seal.

However, this process will be very difficult, but as the level increases and they are constantly stimulated, their chances of awakening will increase.

If it can be upgraded to level 100, the chance is very high. "

It turned out to be like this, Wang Shuo suddenly realized.

"That is to say, giving them medicine now will only enhance the power of the soul, but it will not help much in awakening?"

"It can be said that the earlier they take it, the stronger their soul power will be, and the power of the seal will be stronger, which will hinder their awakening."

Wang Shuo was surprised.

He told Zhao Bond about the phenomenon that Ayub and Gong Zheng can have more emotions.

"This must be a sign that the soul seal is loose!" Wang Shuo asked seriously.

Zhao Bond nodded and said: "That's right, but it's not that simple to break through the soul seal."

At this time, he recalled the difficult process of regaining his memory and couldn't help but sigh.

"However, you need to note that once tool people like them who are recruited by the lord awaken their self-awareness, their loyalty may change because they already have independent personalities."

Wang Shuo nodded and said calmly: "Let's talk about it then! It's too early to say this now."

After Wang Shuo said goodbye to Zhao Bond, he returned to the territory.

The summoning scroll was used immediately.

Wang Shuo has now figured out the principle of this summoning scroll.

Stronger organizations or individuals can use special means to make such scrolls.

Scrolls usually state specific requirements, such as mercenary summoning scrolls, which are summoned to help fight.

For example, the life profession summoning scroll comes to help you make items, or do things according to the employer's requirements.

This type of scroll is equivalent to giving employers and employees an opportunity to discuss business face to face.

There was a flash of white light.

A tall man with thick eyebrows walked out, wearing a gray sweatshirt with a gopher pattern painted on his chest.

Wang Shuo narrowed his eyes, pulled back his face, and twitched the corners of his mouth unnaturally.

Talent!

He couldn't believe that an uncle who dressed in such a style could actually be an architect.

"Did you summon me here?" The big man's face was dark and his voice was rough.

"Yes, my name is Wang Shuo, what do you call me?" Wang Shuo responded politely.

These people must have been summoned from outside the territory. If they can build a good relationship, they may be able to gain unexpected rewards.

"You can also call me, Mr. Architect." The big man said with some embarrassment, his face feeling slightly hot.

Wang Shuo thought to himself, is this guy so arrogant?

He directly checked it with the "Eye of Delirium".

Good guy!

This architect is actually called Xiao Laoteng.

Wang Shuo tried his best not to laugh. After all, he had received professional training.

"Little... um! Master Architect, I am calling you here this time to ask you to teach me how to draw the defensive runes on the bricks of the Black Iron City."

"Um!? This kind of teaching task depends on your qualifications. If you don't have the talent in this area, I can't teach it."

"And the fee for this kind of task is not low!" Xiao Laoteng said leisurely, and he had been observing Wang Shuo's expression with sharp eyes.

Wang Shuo naturally saw the other party's purpose, wasn't it just to see someone's quotation?
